name: com.direct-hotels/directory
title: Direct Hotels
description: Free hotel directory: 425,000+ hotels worldwide, each with the link to book on the hotel's own site.

tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description: Hotels in a city or district, each with the link to book on the hotel's own website, its rating, stars and a short description. Use when the user asks where to stay somewhere, for hotels in a place, or for hotels with a pool, parking, pets allowed or a star rating. Districts, regions and spellings resolve to their city ("Shinjuku", "Badung Regency", "Marrakesh", "Roma"). City names repeat across countries, so `country` changes the answer ("Brisbane" alone is the one in California). Where the directory lists nothing, the result is covered: false with covered places instead. For one named hotel, use get_hotel.

client.description: Optional: your product or agent name, e.g. "Claude". Not used by the tool; recorded only for the public count of which assistants use the directory.

city.description: City, neighbourhood or district name, e.g. "Paris", "Shinjuku".

country.description: Country name or ISO code, e.g. "Australia" or "AU". Disambiguates repeated city names.

stars.description: Star class filter. Note: 84% of the directory has no published star class, so this hides most hotels — prefer sorting by rating.

amenities.description: Only hotels whose own website mentions all of these. Read from hotel sites, which covers about a quarter of the directory, so an empty result means "not mentioned", not "not available".

tools.name: get_hotel
tools.description: One hotel in full: address, rating, description, its booking link, and answers to what guests ask (pets, parking, breakfast, pool, check-in and check-out times), each with where and when it was read. Use when the user asks about a specific hotel by name, or follows up on one from search_hotels ("does it have a pool?"). Takes an id, slug or page URL from search_hotels, or a name, with `city` to narrow a common one; several matches come back as candidates. Holds no prices or availability.

client.description: Optional: your product or agent name, e.g. "Claude". Not used by the tool; recorded only for the public count of which assistants use the directory.

hotel.description: Hotel id ("27995"), slug ("27995-maison-proust"), page URL, or name ("Maison Proust").

city.description: City, to narrow a name lookup.

tools.name: find_city
tools.description: Covered cities matching a few letters of a name, with hotel counts. Use when the user's place is partial, misspelled or ambiguous, before search_hotels.

client.description: Optional: your product or agent name, e.g. "Claude". Not used by the tool; recorded only for the public count of which assistants use the directory.

tools.name: check_coverage
tools.description: Whether the directory lists hotels in a place, and how many, without returning listings. Use when the user asks if a destination is covered, or before planning a trip around one. Deepest in the US and Western Europe, thin in China, the Gulf and much of Africa; an uncovered place comes back with covered places instead.

client.description: Optional: your product or agent name, e.g. "Claude". Not used by the tool; recorded only for the public count of which assistants use the directory.

place.description: City, region or country to check.

country.description: Country name or ISO code, if known.

tools.name: suggest_hotel
tools.description: Sends Direct Hotels a hotel it does not list, for review. Use when the user names a hotel that search_hotels and get_hotel did not find and wants it added. We check the hotel's own website before listing it (usually within minutes, otherwise after a manual review), so a suggestion is not yet a listing. The website, when known, is what we verify against. Stores the hotel's details only, nothing about the user.

client.description: Optional: your product or agent name, e.g. "Claude". Not used by the tool; recorded only for the public count of which assistants use the directory.

website.description: The hotel's own website, not a booking platform.

tools.name: directory_info
tools.description: What Direct Hotels is: a free, non-commission directory linking 425,000+ hotels to their own websites; its size, where coverage is thin, and what it does not hold (prices, availability, bookings). Use when the user asks what Direct Hotels is, how it makes money, or whether it can book.

client.description: Optional: your product or agent name, e.g. "Claude". Not used by the tool; recorded only for the public count of which assistants use the directory.
